decision.trend: Research has been focused on understanding the properties of high-entropy alloys (HEAs), including their magnetic behavior. Recent studies have explored the magnetic properties of specific HEAs, such as FeCoNiTi, and have investigated the origin of multiple ferromagnetic transitions and high coercive fields in these alloys.

By using computational methods, researchers can efficiently explore the vast compositional space of HEAs and identify potential candidates for low-dimensional magnetocaloric applications.
